scale_note: Working scale follows the clean-photo pixel ratio and a plausible slim 600 ml aerosol-can envelope. It is not a measured dimension of the physical can.

proportion_source.reference_note: The user six-view sheet is an uncalibrated generated visual reference of the same red AESTARI/KHX aerosol-can design. It is used for cap/recess/bottom topology and for the inferred back-label layout only; it is not a measured turntable and its panel contours are not treated as exact geometry.
proportion_source.visible_structure: One upright red slim aerosol can: red plastic over-cap with a broad rounded top, an oval recessed scoop with a raised elliptical rim and a spray actuator, a dark cap/body seam, a straight cylindrical label-wrapped body, and a silver rolled-aluminium base with a concave bottom dish. The front label carries the AESTARI / 中山凯达 and 克害威 artwork; the back label is not visible in the source photo and is reconstructed from the uncalibrated reference as an inferred layout.
proportion_source.pixel_ratios: Clean photo alpha bbox x=372..656, y=59..1485 (283 px wide, 1427 px tall, height/diameter about 5.04). Cap seam is at y about 300; the visible silver base starts near y=1440. The candidate reproduces the photo ratio, not a catalogue measurement.
proportion_source.catalog_note: The asset catalogue lists a similar slim aerosol envelope (215-270 mm tall, 53-65 mm diameter, basis similar_catalog) from Sarten. That catalogue figure is only a plausibility check for the chosen 298 mm x 59.2 mm working envelope; it is not a measurement of this can.

dimensions.note: Dimensions are derived from the source-photo pixel ratio with the working height fixed at 298 mm. They are not measured.

recess_cutter.note: Ellipsoid subtracted from the closed cap solid. It creates an oval scoop whose floor is part of the cap; it is not a through-hole.

recess_rim.note: Raised elliptical lip around the scoop, visible as the bright U-shaped rim in the photo. Height/depth are inferred from the uncalibrated reference and photo highlight.

actuator.note: Low oval spray button inside the scoop. Its exact height and mechanism are inferred; only the general actuator presence is supported by the reference.

nozzle.note: Black plastic nozzle insert with a real axial through-hole. The hole diameter and insert length are inferred, not measured.

cap_seam_ring.note: Thin dark shadow/gap line at the cap/body joint. It is inset behind the cap's widest ring so it is not visible as a separate dark halo in the top view, while a hairline remains visible from the side.

features.cap_mould_seam_note: A faint vertical mould seam is drawn into the cap texture at the +X front centre; it is surface-only, not a structural split.

body.note: Printed label is a dielectric ink layer; the aluminium can wall is not exposed on the visible body. Metalness is zero on the print, not because the can is plastic.

cap.note: Glossy red moulded plastic over-cap. Fine orange-peel and flow lines are synthesised; no measured surface profile exists.

base.note: Stamped/rolled aluminium base. Metalness is full and highlights must move with live lighting. Brush marks and local stains are inferred.

texture_sampling.note: Front half of the cylindrical body is projected from the clean photograph; the back half is a red base plus an explicitly inferred back label. Grime is derived from the rust photograph difference, clamped so the print does not turn black.
